title: Research: project a 96-output F17 demand and screen its retained-centre budget
body:
PR[2512](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2512) actually demands 96 ordinary `y1_U` arrays in `F_U1=F17`. This projects PR[2707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2707)'s complete inverse onto that endpoint, using all 112 current Y fields and no early T retention or current X reads. The changed 1,410-event word returns the 96 owned outputs, clears sixteen owned full-cover temporaries and eight owner-private scratch fields, and leaves every borrowed input untouched.

The complete local invoice is **112 H1**, **224 native wrappers**, **208 cover maps**, 560 unit ADDs, 384 quarter ADDs and 144 CLEARs: **9,376 real scalar primitive allowance**. Relative to the full 224-output decoder, this genuinely removes 224 H1, 448 wrappers, 256 maps and 16,464 scalar allowance. It drops future-logger reversal, the F0 inverse and unrelated recovery; it does not lower the tariff of unchanged recursive calls.

The budget conclusion changes in a material way:

- **The old rank-eight-waived obstruction does not extend to this reduced demand.** Its favorable moment is [0.999995759681, 0.999995760274].
- Keeping the reported eight H8 per call under the same centre 64 pair-rate model instead gives **[1.000023149708, 1.000023150305] > 1**, even with every physical overhead free.
- With those H8 fixed, the integer screen permits at most 61 decoder H1 per pair, so this word needs at least 51 fewer genuine pair charges merely to pass it.
- With 112 H1 fixed, two H8 across the pair pass while three fail; at least fourteen of the reported sixteen pair H8 charges would have to disappear without compensating costs under unchanged coverage. No legal copy retirement is supplied.

These are conditional fixed-profile necessary-budget results, not a global lower bound or a claim that the eight H8 survive every changed outer demand. The actual published local endpoint is pinned; a full selected outer continuation requiring only those 96 outputs remains unproved. Physical movement/placement, numerical grids and dirty ranges, both supplier caps, output lifetimes and changed-coverage obligations remain open. The favorable passing waiver is not supplier admission or permission to expand construction. No new kappa or frontier change.

Only `research/qq16-f17-demand-projection/` is added. PROOF.md gives the ordered identity, physical-frame argument, complete local counts and stopping rule; WORD.json and RESULT.json are checked in full. Compared with PR[2512](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2512)'s same logical output and different input/lifetime premises, the new interface needs sixteen additional current Y reads and sixteen full-cover temporaries; it does not claim unconditional dominance or global storage savings.

Validation on Linux CPython 3.12.3, standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -Werror -B research/qq16-f17-demand-projection/verify.py
python3 -I -O -Werror -B research/qq16-f17-demand-projection/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-f17-demand-projection
```

Observed locally: exact demanded routed rows on independent current Y and independent pre-B1 x1/y1 symbols, all 73-coordinate frame phases, 57,344 positive native basis columns, nine semantic mutants, complete primitive invoice and exact rational threshold brackets. Seven boundary groups pass, including a read-only Git-free export, pre-execution source authentication and whole-word/typed receipt rejection. Registered replay and metadata/pins pass. VERIFICATION.json records commands, environment and unrun obligations; published-byte/source-history preflight passes at head 996ff698d3efd0bdce606e240f3b00e6ab91e7fc for 36 package/input files. [Upstream run 39210769816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39210769816) passed both planning and package replay at final head 996ff698d3efd0bdce606e240f3b00e6ab91e7fc. Its log binds the merge into base 20ecf289, CPython 3.12.15, seven tests in 18.918 seconds, the registered completion marker and unchanged committed inputs. Replay explicitly adapts authenticated predecessor primitives; it is not a code-disjoint reimplementation of all inherited algebra, independent human review, physical tape execution or selected cold replay.

Explicit assigned follow-up of #3946/#3908; canonical main 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, priority 6, refreshed at round start, budget checkpoint and before publication, unchanged. Frozen sources and selected science are untouched. Targeted live PR searches, visible Discussion handoffs and local semantic-overlap checks found the named adjacent scopes; the overlap helper lacks gh and complete remote snapshots, so coverage is partial. [Canonical advance claim/update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3946#issuecomment-6260950964).

**Next bounded audit:** trace the actual eight rank-eight centre-copy outputs into one real continuation of this 96-output demand. Pin source/destination/frame/last use and prove legal retirement or continued need, recomputing coverage and charging cleanup. Do not grant the waiver free. TASK.json has concrete first steps, blockers and stop conditions.
